name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Tabbed panels with an animated indicator, plus a tab-styled navigation bar.

classes.name: tabs
classes.description: Stacks the tab list above the panels.

classes.name: tabs__list
classes.description: The bar holding the tab buttons. The sliding indicator follows the selected tab.

classes.name: tabs__button
classes.description: A tab. Combine it with btn. Selected when aria-selected="true" (tabs) or aria-current="page" (navigation).

attributes.name: data-tabs-index
attributes.description: Index of the selected tab, starting at 0. Updated as tabs change. Defaults to 0.

attributes.name: data-tabs-target="tab"
attributes.description: The panels, in the same order as the buttons. Start them hidden.

attributes.name: data-tabs-action
attributes.description: "select" on each button; "keydown.left->prev keydown.right->next" on the list.

actions.name: prev
actions.description: Selects and focuses the previous tab.

actions.name: next
actions.description: Selects and focuses the next tab.

events.name: velle:tabs:change
events.description: Dispatched whenever the visible tab is set, including on connect. event.detail.index is the selected index.

notes: The selected button gets aria-selected="true" and tabindex="0"; the others get tabindex="-1", so Tab moves straight into the panel.
For navigation between pages, use tabs__list and tabs__button without JavaScript and mark the current link with aria-current="page".
